description: Topic codebook and keyword-baseline rules for Part 08, shared by the Python notebook (annotate.py) and the R Markdown document so both apply exactly the same instrument.
codebook: TASK: Assign each Bluesky post from a news organization's account exactly one
topic label.
LABELS
politics - The post is primarily about government, elections, campaigns,
political parties, politicians acting in office or as candidates, courts and
law enforcement as institutions, legislation, public policy (including
immigration and visas), the military, war, diplomacy, espionage, or
political protest and mobilization.
science_tech - The post is primarily about scientific research and its
findings, medicine and health science, regulatory decisions about scientific
or technical substance, artificial intelligence, consumer technology, or the
technology industry (companies, products, deals, and investors).
other - Everything else: crime, accidents, and natural disasters reported as
events; sports; arts, entertainment, and celebrities; food and recipes;
shopping, advice, and lifestyle service pieces; games and puzzles; and
promotions for the publisher's own newsletters, podcasts, and products.
DECISION RULES
1. Code the post's PRIMARY topic: what the story is mostly about, not every
topic it touches.
2. Sports, entertainment, and human-interest settings: if a political actor
(a president, a government agency) or a public policy (immigration rules,
security operations) is the main subject, code politics. A politician who
appears only incidentally does not make a post political.
3. Crime, disasters, and accidents are other, unless the post's focus is
policy, a government response, a political actor, or political
mobilization around the event.
4. Officials acting in a personal capacity (a judge charged with assault
after a parking-lot dispute) are other: the story is not about the
institution.
5. A regulator's decision about scientific or technical substance (an agency
approving a drug or a sunscreen ingredient) is science_tech. A political
fight over that regulation is politics.
6. Technology-industry business news (initial public offerings, product
launches, investor skepticism) is science_tech. Government regulation or
political pressure on technology companies is politics.
7. Opinion columns and promotions of the publisher's journalism are coded by
the topic of the piece being promoted.
8. If the topic cannot be determined from the text alone (a link with no
description, a reaction to an image we cannot see), code other.
keyword_matching: Lowercase the post; count whole-word, case-insensitive matches of every keyword (a regular expression \b<keyword>\b, non-overlapping); the category with the most matches wins; a tie, or no matches at all, gives default_label. Keywords contain only lowercase letters, digits, spaces, hyphens and inner periods.
